features.title: Lightweight architecture and quality harness
Workflow AST, command manifest, result and event protocols
Immutable catalog and static workflow compiler
Cancellation-aware orchestrator with terminal run evidence
Explicit-session Playwright browser executor
Isolated Python worker for data commands
Deterministic search-and-save CLI workflow
Stable errors, cancellation cleanup, bounded retry, and reliable evidence
Typed side effects, idempotency, and replay policy
Explicit-session Windows desktop executor and deterministic E2E
One-way typed import of legacy element data
Safe node-boundary checkpoints and recovery semantics
Deliberate node-boundary pause and continuation of a run
First API surface decision recorded as an accepted ADR
Caller-facing API usage documentation with runnable example
Win32 timeoutMs symmetry and data.format template rendering
Design-time dev server with catalog, compile, and workflow file APIs
Zero-build single-page editor with linear canvas and compile echo
Desktop UIA hit-test and browser element capture with S1-verified transport
Structured tree canvas with nested drag-drop, multi-select, copy-paste, and snapshot undo
Plain-text file output and list truncation data commands
Editor visual polish with Chinese display layer
Editor element library browsing and insertion of captured descriptors
WorkBuddy CLI connector with auth trio and skill package
BrowserSkill (bsk) capture transport and element library capture entry
Per-flow workflow directories with elements as flow assets
CLI channel parity: catalog, capture, elements subcommands
Editor advanced: variable completion, fullscreen canvas, run status highlight
Editor run control: run/cancel/status via devserver subprocess host
Silent browser extension install: CRX packing, devserver hosting, policy registry with UAC fallback
Guided extension install entry: per-browser status detection and install from CLI and editor
Editor interaction polish: resizable panels, bottom element library tabs, capture/run UX
Command param enrichment: sessionId resourceType tagging + existing command parameter additions from Yingdao analysis
New commands batch 1: browser.hover, desktop.activateWindow/setWindowState/setWindowVisible/moveWindow/resizeWindow/getWindowTitle/getSelectedText
New commands batch 2: browser.executeScript/screenshot/select, desktop.screenshot/select/drag
New commands batch 3: browser.upload/download/handleDialog, desktop.getWindowList
User variable system: ActionNode.output_name + scopes.variables + ${var_name} reference
Per-flow data table (yingdao-aligned): design-time columns + runtime data.table.* commands + editor grid + CSV export
Yingdao-aligned batch1: data.readText/appendText/fileExists/deletePath/datetimeNow + workflow.sleep
Native desktop client slice1 (ADR 0014 option E): PySide6 optional gui extra, rpa-core gui entry, catalog command tree with search/filter
Native desktop client slice2: flow card canvas - Workflow AST to Qt tree model, then/else/catch virtual groups, card delegate, in-model drag/drop with cycle guard
Native desktop client slice3: parameter schema form - input_schema to native widgets (enum/string/integer/boolean/JSON), right panel binds to selected canvas card with apply-to-model
Native desktop client slice4: edit round-trip - flow tree model rebuilds Workflow AST (preserving condition/items/item_var/catch), save to workflow.json with validation, dirty tracking and Save As

Native desktop client slice5: node add/delete - double-click command tree appends new action at selection-aware target (container/then/sibling), Delete removes selected node with root/virtual-group protection, unique node ids

GUI/Web parity: control-node param forms, undo/redo + copy/paste, fx variable tags, compile validation, run control (RunManager), flow library, element library + desktop capture, data table, catalog/extension dialogs
Native Messaging extension bridge: browser-spawned host over local IPC (named pipe / unix socket), retiring the resident 8765 hub and long-poll channel
GUI run control advanced: cross-process pause/continue control channel and human-confirmed recovery for indeterminate/recovery_required runs
GUI UX parity with Yingdao/Web editor: single-entry hybrid capture (done), canvas multi-select/context-menu/search, param-group + output-alias forms, failure-location loop

Native messaging transport verified on macOS real machine (unix socket endpoint + host manifest registration + end-to-end); Linux recorded-only per maintainer decision 2026-09-20 (no Linux environment, design/unit-test coverage stands)
Debugger: node breakpoints (stop before a node, consumed-on-resume) and single-step resume over the M21 cross-process pause channel
Run history: list past runs from run_artifacts, open an event timeline, jump to nodes, re-run with the same inputs, and resume/step a paused run

Flow inputs declaration editor: create/edit/remove workflow inputs in the GUI (name + JSON default, the two columns the real {name: default} shape has), with validation before accept, wired to the run-params dialog, variable completion and compile checks. Declaration is NOT a filter for run inputs (history replay passes through unchanged). S1-S4 done.

Workbench home window (ADR 0017): flow list with run status, global run history tab with filtering, flow management actions (incl. cascading delete with confirmation), and a run entry that hands control to the editor

Element self-healing: consume captured candidate selectors at runtime, pre-action validation (visibility/disabled/occlusion), classified element errors, and fix the declared-but-unimplemented input params (keyIntervalMs, clipboard)

Browser command param contract: implement declared-but-inert click params (simulateHuman/clickPosition with point-accurate occlusion precheck), forward cookie filters and tabId, drop unreachable screenshot/close params, and gate every declared param against actual executor consumption

Desktop command param contract: the param-consumption gate covers all four channels (78 commands, 0 skipped); every declared-but-inert desktop param is resolved — wait-for-element timeoutMs, click simulateHuman/clickPosition, attachWindow className on uia — and the two win32 params with no counterpart are dropped. Includes a new error-contract gate (manifest errors must cover returned codes). S1-S5 done.
Browser teardown: close tabs (explicit/all) and terminate ALL processes of the named browser (kill-all semantics; M35 removed the launchedByUs/byProcessName scope)
Extension bridge host idle self-termination: exit when no client connected and idle past threshold (default 30min, disabled via RPA_CORE_HOST_IDLE_EXIT_SECONDS=0)

Element post-capture UX (M39): align the GUI verify button's wording with the Web 'structural check' semantics; surface captured-but-never-shown data (selector.candidates with measured matchedCount, semantic features, page fingerprint, desktop className/name); and an offline element editor (promote a candidate to primary with swap semantics, checkbox the desktop locator fields scoped per backend, in-place structural validation). S1-S3 done.
